All three failures remain retained; product candidate15 is unchanged.

Can this be done on the VM? Yes — unchanged installed candidate15, isolated guest, owned local WebDAV, synthetic SSH password, actual input/framebuffer and no personal cloud or physical device.

- [x] The successful fresh owner has consistent four-channel completion, unchanged seals, actual owner/guest/backend cleanup and a hash-bound primary frame review.
